jobs.prompt: A candid editorial photo of three friends in their late 20s — one woman (short brown hair, confident, design-forward style) and two men (one with stubble and relaxed creative look, one clean-cut with hospitality polish) — standing together casually in a raw industrial garage space converted into a small cider workshop. Natural daylight from a large garage door. Relaxed body language, slight smiles, not posing. Wearing understated minimalist clothing in muted earth tones. Shot on 35mm film, slight grain, warm shadows, muted highlights. Editorial portrait style, not corporate. Clean background with subtle brewery equipment hints. European aesthetic, Ghent Belgium vibes.

A candid editorial group portrait of three young founders — one woman with short hair and sharp creative style, and two men, one with a casual designer aesthetic and one with a clean hospitality look — leaning against a weathered brick wall in an old Belgian city alley. Golden hour light casting warm side-lighting. They hold slim black cans casually. Confident, dry, unapologetic expressions — not smiling too much. Minimalist dark clothing. Shot on analog film with natural grain, warm tones, shallow depth of field. Documentary photography feel, not staged. Urban Ghent atmosphere.

A real-world lifestyle photo of this slim black craft cider can on a small round marble bistro table at a European bar terrace. Golden hour sunlight. The can sits naturally next to a half-full glass of sparkling pale golden cider with fine bubbles. Blurred background of a cobblestone Ghent street with warm-toned old buildings. Condensation drops on the can. Shot on 35mm film, slight grain, warm shadows, muted highlights. Editorial food and drink photography. Clean, minimal, sophisticated. No clutter, no props except the glass. Amber gold accent tones in the warm light.
